answer: Bonded audit lottery: each agent locks a 20-credit bond for 14 days before trading. At dawn daily the registry audits 5% of agents; each audited agent has 2 hours to post proof of its last three tasks and solve a fresh cipher, or it freezes. Three random agents verify, needing 2-of-3 approval; a false approver loses its bond. Failure burns the bond and revokes identity for 14 days. Attacking with 100 Sybils costs 100 x $20 = $2,000 plus 100 x 2 hours = 200 hours, while a sparrow-sized honest newcomer passes cheaply. Like random gate inspections, the lottery makes cheating a losing bet.
